title: DeepSeek Releases Updated V4.1 Flash Model
excerpt: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek has launched an updated version of its Flash model featuring improvements in coding and agentic tasks.
body_html:
Chinese artificial intelligence company DeepSeek has rolled out an updated version of its Flash model, designated as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017.

The new release brings notable enhancements in programming capabilities and agentic tasks. Additionally, the updated model offers more affordable execution for agent-based operations.

The launch continues the company's ongoing developments in its AI model lineup, focusing on performance upgrades and cost efficiency for specialized workloads.
